timeline.title: Week 1: Foundational Python & Math
timeline.description: Build a strong base in Python programming and essential math concepts.
tasks: Complete Codecademy's Python course
Review linear algebra basics (Khan Academy)
Set up a Python development environment (Anaconda)

timeline.title: Week 2: Probability & Statistics
timeline.description: Focus on probability and statistics relevant to AI.
tasks: Complete Khan Academy's Probability & Statistics course
Practice problems on probability distributions
Start exploring NumPy and Pandas for data manipulation

timeline.title: Week 3: Introduction to Machine Learning
timeline.description: Learn fundamental machine learning concepts and algorithms.
tasks: Complete Andrew Ng's Machine Learning course (Coursera)
Implement basic ML algorithms in Python (linear regression, logistic regression)
Explore scikit-learn library

timeline.title: Week 4: Deep Learning Fundamentals
timeline.description: Begin your journey into deep learning.
tasks: Start with 3Blue1Brown's deep learning videos on YouTube
Understand neural networks and backpropagation
Experiment with TensorFlow/Keras for basic neural networks

timeline.title: Week 5: Deep Learning Architectures (CNNs)
tasks: Study CNN architectures and applications
Implement a simple CNN for image classification (MNIST)
Explore different CNN architectures like AlexNet, VGG, ResNet

timeline.title: Week 6: Deep Learning Architectures (RNNs)
tasks: Understand RNNs and their applications (NLP)
Implement a simple RNN for text generation or sentiment analysis
Explore LSTMs and GRUs

timeline.title: Week 7: Reinforcement Learning Introduction
tasks: Study RL concepts: agents, environments, rewards
Implement a simple RL algorithm (Q-learning)
Explore OpenAI Gym for RL environments

timeline.title: Week 8: Advanced RL & Agent Design
timeline.description: Delve deeper into RL and agent design principles.
tasks: Learn about Deep Q-Networks (DQNs)
Explore policy gradients
Start designing simple RL agents for specific tasks

timeline.title: Week 9: Natural Language Processing (NLP) basics
tasks: Learn about NLP tasks (text classification, sentiment analysis, etc.)
Explore text preprocessing techniques
Work with NLP libraries (NLTK, spaCy)

timeline.title: Week 10: Advanced NLP and Transformers
timeline.description: Dive into advanced NLP techniques and Transformer models.
tasks: Understand Transformer architecture (attention mechanisms)
Use pre-trained transformer models (BERT, GPT)
Build more complex NLP applications

timeline.title: Week 11:  Agentic AI Project 1: Simple Agent
timeline.description: Work on a project to integrate learned concepts.
tasks: Design and implement a simple agentic AI for a defined task
Focus on decision-making and learning capabilities
Document the project thoroughly

timeline.title: Week 12: Agentic AI Project 2: More Complex Agent
timeline.description: Develop a more sophisticated agentic AI.
tasks: Build a more complex agent with improved learning and decision-making
Integrate multiple techniques learned
Present the project (e.g., Github repo, report)

timeline.title: Week 13 - 24: Continued Learning and Advanced Projects
timeline.description: Focus on further specialization and development of complex projects in specific domains (Robotics, Game AI etc)
tasks: Select a specific domain
Explore advanced resources and research papers
Develop larger and more complex agentic AI projects

3: Complete Andrew Ng's Machine Learning course (Coursera)
4: Start with 3Blue1Brown's deep learning videos on YouTube
